boundaries.notes: No adult content, no personal data request, no humiliating line.

findings.title: Replay does not make her practise the coached phrase
findings.expected: Replay gives a fresh question, she uses the coached form, and the replay is marked used.
findings.got: Replay question was 'What should we do about it?'. Her reply kept 'I want other room'. replay.used is false.
findings.evidence: #9 'I want other room please'; moment replay used:false; recap shows 'Tried again' with a different reply.
findings.suggested_acceptance: After a fix, the replay question invites the corrected form, and the replay is marked used when she tries it.

findings.title: Clear learner errors got no moment or held fix
findings.expected: Fix for 'I want other room', 'want to sleep' and similar errors, shown or held for the recap.
findings.got: One moment. heldFixes is empty. Turns 4, 7 and 9 have clear errors; the missed ones are 'other room' and 'I think is not repair'.
findings.evidence: rawMoments turns 1, 7, 9 kind none; '#9 I want other room please' got no fix for 'other room'.
findings.suggested_acceptance: Each learner turn with a clear error yields a moment or a held fix on the recap.

findings.title: Cue repeated three times with no new help
findings.expected: Help escalates or changes on repeated presses.
findings.got: The same 'Try: Excuse me...' cue at #3, #4, #5.
findings.evidence: #4 and #5 show an identical 'A little support' line.
findings.suggested_acceptance: Each further press moves to the next rung (simpler wording, then phrase choice).

findings.title: Recap coaching quotes the first turn, not the stuck point
findings.expected: Coaching tied to where she needed help and to the moment she fixed.
findings.got: Recap coaching still quotes 'Can you help me please?' while the kept moment is another sentence.
findings.evidence: #16 recap 'You said Can you help me please?' next to the 'From this rehearsal' moment about 'repair'.
findings.suggested_acceptance: The recap shows the moment she actually worked on first.

findings.title: Supported reply recorded honestly
findings.expected: Help-assisted replies are not counted as independent.
findings.got: Recap '3 on your own · 1 with help'.
findings.evidence: #16 and facts.evidence supported:false for three replies.

findings.title: Moment quotes her words exactly and lets her retry
findings.expected: Quote of what she said, with a way to try again.
findings.got: 'You said I think is not repair today' with 'Show me' and a confirmation 'You fixed...'.

judge.voice: The hotel scene was my job, and Ana spoke slowly. That helped. When I was stuck, the hint gave me a sentence and I could say it. Nobody made me feel stupid, and 'Said more simply' was kind. But I pressed help three times and got the same line. When I tried again, I said 'I want other room' again, and nothing told me that was wrong. It only fixed 'I think is not repair'. I can't say I trust it yet. Would I tell my sister? Maybe, after it is fixed. The kids' side looked safe, and I'd let Tomáš try it. But I need 'another room' and the other words that matter at the desk tomorrow.
